dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.en: Hi! What can I get for you?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Hi. Could I get a large brown sugar milk tea, please? With boba.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.en: Sure. How sweet would you like it?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Not too sweet, please — half sugar if you have that.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.en: No problem. For here or to go?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: To go, please. How long will it take?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.en: About five minutes. That'll be eighteen yuan.

expressions.en: What can I get for you?
expressions.zh: 店员点单时很常用，「您要点什么？」

expressions.en: For here or to go? / to go

expressions.zh: 珍珠/波霸；也可指整杯奶茶。
结账时报价的口语说法。
